newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 2.0 bln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 2.0 bln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 2.0 billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Monday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Tuesday.
It accepted bids for 41.1 billion francs in new liquidity, two billion more than the 39.1 billion leaving the market on Tuesday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on April 1.
The Bank of France said it allocated 12.1 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 3.8 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 29.0 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 12.2 percent of this demand.
